1:1: These are the words that Moshe addressed to all of Yisroel

He reproved them for they had sinned in the wilderness, and for provoking to anger on the plain facing the Sea of Suf; in Poron, where they scorned the mon, and in Chatzeiros, where they provoked to anger regarding meat, and for making the Golden Calf.
1:2: A journey of eleven days [traveling time] from Choreiv
1:4: After he had smitten Sichon, King of the Emorites,
who was living in Ashtoros, in Edrei.
1:5: Across the Yardein in the land of Moav,
to elucidate the teachings of this Torah as follows:
1:7: Turn and travel for yourselves and arrive at the Emorite hill [region] and at all its habitable places —
on the plain, on the mountain, and in the lowland, and in the Negev, and on the seacoast;
the land of the Canaanites and the Lebanon,
up to the great river, the Euphrates River.
1:13: Provide yourselves men, wise and understanding and renowned to your tribes,
and I will appoint them to be chiefs over you.’’
1:14: and said, ‘‘[It is a] right thing that you said to do.’’
1:15: I took the leaders of your tribes, men wise and renowned,
masters of thousands and masters of hundreds, and masters of fifties and masters of tens,
and court officers for your tribes.
1:17: Do not show favor in judgement; words small and great alike will you hear out;
And the matter that will be too difficult for you,
present to me and I will hear it.’’
1:19: We traveled from Choreiv and walked the entire great wilderness, that awesome one that you saw, in the direction of the Emorite hill [region]
as Adonoy, our God, commanded us;
1:26: But you were unwilling to go up,
and you were rebellious against the word of Adonoy, your God.
1:28: Where are we going up to? Our brothers have broken our hearts by saying, ‘A people greater and more powerful than we,
and also descendants of the giants — did we see there.’’’
1:29: ‘‘Do not be broken-hearted and do not fear them.
1:30: He will wage war for you,
as in everything that He did with you in Egypt before your eyes;
1:32: you do not trust the word of Adonoy, your God,
1:33: Who has been leading you on the road to prepare for you a place to encamp;
with the pillar of fire at night to show you the way for you to go on,
and with the pillar of cloud by day.
1:34: Before Adonoy was heard the intent of your words
1:36: Except for Koleiv ben Yefuneh, who will see it,
and to whom I will give the land that he trod upon and to his sons,
because he was complete in fear of Adonoy.’’
1:37: Also against me was there anger from before Adonoy
1:41: You replied and said to me, ‘‘We have sinned before Adonoy.
We will go up and wage war
in [fulfillment of] all that Adonoy, our God commanded us.’’
And each of you girded his weapons of war,
and you began to go up the mountain.
1:42: Adonoy said to me, ‘‘Say to them, ‘Do not go up and do not wage war,
for My Shechina does not dwell in your midst;
so that you will not be shattered
1:43: I told you, but you did not obey.
You defied the decree of the word of Adonoy,
and deliberately went up the hill.
1:44: The Emorites came out — those who live in those hills — toward you,
and they crushed you in Se’ir till Chorma.
1:45: You returned and wept before Adonoy,
but Adonoy did not accept your prayer;
He did not hearken to your words.
2:7: For Adonoy, your God, has blessed you in all your handiwork;
He has given you sufficient for your needs
It is now forty years [that] the word of Adonoy, your God, has aided you;
2:9: Adonoy said to me, ‘‘Do not besiege Moav
and do not intimidate to make war with them.
For I will not give you [any] of his land as inheritance,
2:10: a people great and numerous and powerful like the giants.
2:11: They, too, were considered giants like the giants;
2:12: And in Seir lived the Chorim originally,
but the descendants of Eisov inherited them and drove them out [to make room] for themselves
as Yisroel will have done to the land of its inheritance
2:14: The time that [it took] us to go from Rekam Geyah until we crossed Wadi Zered
until the end of the entire generation, the men of war, from within the camp,
as Adonoy had sworn about them.
2:15: The plague from before Adonoy, too, attacked them
to destroy them from within the camp,
2:18: ‘‘You are today crossing the border of Moav — at Lechoyas.
2:19: When you approach [the area] facing the descendants of Ammon,
do not besiege them and do not intimidate to make war with them,
for I will not give you of the land of the descendants of Ammon an inheritance,
because to the descendants of Lot have I given it as an inheritance.
2:20: It, too, is considered a land of giants;
giants having lived in it originally —
2:21: A people great and numerous and powerful like the giants.
Adonoy destroyed them from before them,
and they drove them out and settled in their place.
2:22: As He had done to the descendants of Eisov
from before whom He destroyed the Chori,
and they drove them out and settled in their places
2:23: And the Avim who had been living in Defiach till Azah —
destroyed them and settled in their place.
2:24: Arise to travel, and cross Wadi Arnon.
See, I have put into your hand Sichon, King of Cheshbon, the Emorite and his land — begin inheriting [it] by intimidating him
2:29: As the descendants of Eisov did for me who live in Seir
and the Moavites who live in Lechoyas;
until I will have crossed the Yardein
into the land that Adonoy, our God, is giving us.’’
2:30: But Sichon, King of Cheshbon, was not willing
to permit us to pass through his borders,
because Adonoy, your God, had hardened his spirit and emboldened his mind
in order to put him in your hand this day.
2:33: Adonoy, our God, delivered him before us,
and we smote him and his sons and his entire people.
2:37: Only the land of the descendants of Ammon did you not attack —
all along the shore of Wadi Yabok and the hill cities —
3:1: Og, King of Masnan, went out toward us, he and his entire people, to [wage] war in Edrei.
3:4: We conquered all his cities at that time;
that we did not take from them —
sixty cities, the entire province of Tarchona,
the kingdom of Og in the Boshon.
3:9: and the Emorites call it Mount Snow.
3:10: All the cities of the plain and entire Gilod and the entire Masnan
cities of Og’s kingdom in the Boshon.
3:11: For only Og, King of the Boshon, survived from the remainder of the giants.
Look, his bed — an iron bed —
in Rabbas of the descendants of Ammon:
nine amohs its length and four amohs its width, in a king’s amoh.
3:13: And the rest of the Gilod and all of Masnan, the kingdom of Og,
I gave to half the tribe of Menashe.
that is called the land of the giants.
3:14: Yair son of Menashe took all of the Tarchona province
until the border of the Geshurites and the Apekorsites;
and he named them for himself — Masnan — the villages of Yair
3:17: and the Arava and the Yardein and the border;
from Ginosar until Arava Lake, the salt lake,
beneath the slopes of the crest to the east.
3:18: ‘‘Adonoy, your God, has given you this land to inherit it.
Cross over well armed, ahead of your brothers the Bnei Yisroel, all armed soldiers.
3:22: His word is waging war for you.’’
